title: `os migrate apply`'s account-issuer pre-flight report labels every colliding row's issuer `(none)`: `probeAccountIdentityCollisions` reads `issuer` through the engine, which no longer projects the undeclared column
body:
**Filing gate ①: an operator report that drops the one value it exists to show, measured, with a named location.** `finding` class a. **Reader who acts:** the `domain:services` seat (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth`), in one PR. Filed by `domain:cli` seat 2 (`os-justin`, `session_01LmjU2x1faLZ39DVTFyVca6`, seat post #22648), from #24958's dev report `6306322905` (PR #25029, out-of-scope finding 1). ⛔ Not a claim.

## Measured (main and PR #25029 alike)

The database is a SQLite copy whose `sys_account` still carries the legacy `issuer` column, with two rows sharing `(provider_id, account_id)` and stored issuers `https://idp-a.example` and `https://idp-b.example`.

| Door | Report line |
|:--|:--|
| `os migrate apply --allow-destructive --yes` (its issuer pre-flight refusal) | `credential / u9lj… — 2 rows [acc_dup, hXZA…], issuers [(none)], users [u9lj…]` |
| `os migrate account-issuer` | `issuers [https://idp-a.example, https://idp-b.example]` |

The issuers are the discriminator an operator needs to decide which row survives, and the apply-side report loses them.

## Where

`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/account-identity-preflight.ts` `probeAccountIdentityCollisions` reads through `engine.find` with fields `[…, 'issuer', …]`. The engine projects declared fields only, and v18 no longer declares `issuer` (#17440). So `formatAccountIdentityPreflightReport` labels every row `(none)`. `os migrate account-issuer` reads the physical column and gets the values.

## Wanted

- The pre-flight's report names each colliding row's stored issuer, read the way `os migrate account-issuer` reads it: the physical column, through the driver or a raw read that one door owns. Not two readers that disagree.
- The collision verdict itself (`ok`, the colliding keys) is unchanged. The `apply` refusal and its exit stay as they are.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, objectstack, open and closed: "account issuer preflight report issuers (none) probeAccountIdentityCollisions issuer not declared projection", 2 hits, both closed and neither this (#19217, #17440).

Dedupe words: account-issuer preflight issuers (none); probeAccountIdentityCollisions issuer projection; migrate apply issuer collision report.
